entities.name: Al-Mu'tamid ibn Abbad
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: al-Muʿtamid Muḥammad ibn ʿAbbād al-Lakhmī, also known as Abbad III, was the third and last ruler of the Taifa of Seville in Al-Andalus, as well as a renowned poet. He was the final ruler of the Arab Abbadid dynasty of Seville, before being deposed by the Almoravids in 1091.
